package shared

import "path/filepath"

// Agent identifiers for the Antigravity family of agents.
//
// See:
//   - https://antigravity.google/docs/ide/skills
//   - https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/plugins#agent-skills
//   - https://antigravity.google/docs/skills#where-skills-live
const (
	// AntigravityAgentID is the Antigravity IDE (1.x) agent.
	AntigravityAgentID = "antigravity"
	// AntigravityCLIAgentID is the Antigravity CLI agent.
	AntigravityCLIAgentID = "antigravity-cli"
	// Antigravity2AgentID is the Antigravity 2.0 IDE agent.
	Antigravity2AgentID = "antigravity2.0"
)

// AntigravityAgentIDs lists every supported Antigravity agent identifier.
var AntigravityAgentIDs = []string{
	AntigravityAgentID,
	AntigravityCLIAgentID,
	Antigravity2AgentID,
}

// IsAntigravityAgent reports whether agentID names a supported Antigravity agent.
func IsAntigravityAgent(agentID string) bool {
	for _, id := range AntigravityAgentIDs {
		if id == agentID {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// antigravitySkillPathSegments returns the directory segments, relative to a
// user home directory or a project root, where the given Antigravity agent
// looks for skills.
func antigravitySkillPathSegments(agentID string) []string {
	switch agentID {
	case AntigravityCLIAgentID:
		return []string{".antigravity", "cli", "skills"}
	case Antigravity2AgentID:
		return []string{".antigravity", "2.0", "skills"}
	default:
		return []string{".antigravity", "skills"}
	}
}

// AntigravityUserSkillDir returns the user (sitewide) skill directory for the
// given Antigravity agent, rooted at home.
func AntigravityUserSkillDir(agentID, home string) string {
	return filepath.Join(append([]string{home}, antigravitySkillPathSegments(agentID)...)...)
}

// AntigravityProjectSkillDir returns the project-scoped skill directory for the
// given Antigravity agent, rooted at projectRoot.
func AntigravityProjectSkillDir(agentID, projectRoot string) string {
	return filepath.Join(append([]string{projectRoot}, antigravitySkillPathSegments(agentID)...)...)
}
